Project Details:

Project 1 : WorldPay

This project developed streamline the checkout experience and online payment processing so

customers can easily and safely pay how they want and wherever they are. Customers can use a wide array of payment options, including credit and debit card processing, mobile payments, and online payment gateways. Offers advanced fraud protection, data security, and insightful analytics to help businesses optimize their payment processes and enhance customer experiences. By integrating innovative technology and comprehensive support, this project aims to simplify and streamline transactions, driving growth and efficiency for its clients across various industries.

Role & Responsibilities:

Implemented the Backend API using Restful Web Services.

Used various Core Java concepts such as Multi-Threading, Exception Handling,

Collection APIs, Garbage collections.

Developed RESTful Web Services with JAX-RS using Spring Boot and worked on testing

the RESTful APIs

Used Maven as build automation tool and responsible for Jenkins like Continuous

Integration (CI) and Continuous Delivery (CD).

Improving system scalability and reliability. ● Reducing data processing latency. ● Enabling real-time data analytics and insights. ● Involved in unit testing, test case reviews and code reviews in accordance with applicable development standards.

Developed and maintained J2EE components including and Servlets

Analyze the procedure and route the issues to DB team if the issues related to DB.

Implemented client logic through product business functionality.

Implemented Report and Admin microservices from scratch

Implemented Rest API’s and Business service classes for Report and Admin microservices

Implemented action classes based on workflow engine..

Implemented logic for new payment creation for each transaction maintaining funds amount

transaction details like date, fund amount, check no and check type.

Implemented logic for each transaction showing as separate pages funds status information.

Environment/Tools: Java , Hibernate ,Core java, Spring boot, RestAPI, MicroServices, SpringData

JPA, ReactJs, Mongo DB, MySQL, Docker, GitLab, MicroService, Spring Security, Eureka server,

Config server, Rabbit MQ.

Project 2: Apptio

Apptio, a leading TBM SaaS platform used by enterprises to manage and optimize IT financial operations. Built scalable backend services that supported financial modeling, cloud cost optimization, and IT planning across large-scale infrastructures. Leveraged Spring Boot, JPA, REST APIs, Java 8, and multithreading to deliver high-performance solutions, while integrating MySQL, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases. Implemented CI/CD pipelines with

GitHub Actions, automated deployments, and used Kafka for distributed message processing. Worked extensively with AWS services including RDS, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, Kinesis, and SNS to build cloud-native, event-driven architectures. Improved application performance by optimizing complex SQL queries and ensuring secure, scalable deployments. Provided on-call production support, resolved critical issues, monitored system health, and contributed to documentation.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Implemented features using Core Java, Java 8, Micro Services, Spring Boot. ● Written React components to handle UI functionality and React JS and Redux for implementing core functionality and for Integration.

Utilized Dynamo Db and MySQL. ● Participating in client calls and involved in the requirement gathering from the clients. ● Involved in developing business logic in service layer and persistent logic in DAO Layer. ● Involved in bug fixing and maintenance of the application. ● Contribute to ensuring high quality of code by performing unit testing and following best practices.

Set up CI/CD pipelines using [Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.] to automate testing, integration, and deployment processes.

Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for seamless communication between services, ensuring efficient data flow and integration.

Proficient in using Spring Framework for dependency injection, inversion of control (IoC), and aspect-oriented programming (AOP).

Expertise in building RESTful and web applications using Spring MVC with features like data binding, form handling, and request mapping

Designed and implemented microservices architecture to break down monolithic applications into smaller, independent services for better scalability, fault isolation, and maintainability.

Involved in business logic to fetch the data from database ● Involved in fix any defects and performance problems discovered during testing. ● Deployed containerized applications using Amazon ECS/EKS, managing clusters with Docker and Kubernetes.

Environment: Java,Java8, Hibernate, Spring Security, Spring IOC, Restfull Web services, Spring Boot with Micro Services, Angular Junit,Mockito,Tomcat 7, Eclipse,Teamcity,SonarQube,postman,OracleSQL Developer,Aws.

,ReactJS

Project-3: B2BBridge

Project name

: B2BBridge

Environment/Tools: Java / J2EE, Spring Boot, Restful web services, ReactsJs, Microservices,Kafka,

MongoDB, Reactjs Hibernate ,Tomcat.

Description:

B2BBridge is a centralized booking and tracking system with an automated dispatching and handling mechanism. Multiple Cab Agencies can connect and handle their bookings with their software. It provides some feature like intercity bookings, Airport bookings, Outstation bookings, Cab for Bus Bookings, Public shared taxi (PST) and Posting bookings, Posting Vehicles to other Cab agencies with their mutual understanding. 3rd party APIs for map and SMS are used in this project.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Developed Airport bookings complete module. ● Developed Public Shared Taxi (PST) Complete module. ● Involved in development of Post Booking module. ● Involved in development of Admin module. ● Direct Client Interaction and fixing Issues. ● Provide user Security for individual cab agency.

Involved in maintenance of this project. ● Involved in Writing SQL Queries and JDBC code to establish connection with MySQL.

Declaration:

I hereby declare that all the above furnished details are true to the best of my

knowledge.

sections.text:
Project Details:
Project 1 : WorldPay
This project developed streamline the checkout experience and online payment processing so
customers can easily and safely pay how they want and wherever they are. Customers can use a wide array of payment options, including credit and debit card processing, mobile payments, and online payment gateways. Offers advanced fraud protection, data security, and insightful analytics to help businesses optimize their payment processes and enhance customer experiences. By integrating innovative technology and comprehensive support, this project aims to simplify and streamline transactions, driving growth and efficiency for its clients across various industries.
Role & Responsibilities:
Implemented the Backend API using Restful Web Services.
Used various Core Java concepts such as Multi-Threading, Exception Handling,
Collection APIs, Garbage collections.
Developed RESTful Web Services with JAX-RS using Spring Boot and worked on testing
the RESTful APIs
Used Maven as build automation tool and responsible for Jenkins like Continuous
Integration (CI) and Continuous Delivery (CD).
Improving system scalability and reliability. ● Reducing data processing latency. ● Enabling real-time data analytics and insights. ● Involved in unit testing, test case reviews and code reviews in accordance with applicable development standards.
Developed and maintained J2EE components including and Servlets
Analyze the procedure and route the issues to DB team if the issues related to DB.
Implemented client logic through product business functionality.
Implemented Report and Admin microservices from scratch
Implemented Rest API’s and Business service classes for Report and Admin microservices
Implemented action classes based on workflow engine..
Implemented logic for new payment creation for each transaction maintaining funds amount
transaction details like date, fund amount, check no and check type.
Implemented logic for each transaction showing as separate pages funds status information.
Environment/Tools: Java , Hibernate ,Core java, Spring boot, RestAPI, MicroServices, SpringData
JPA, ReactJs, Mongo DB, MySQL, Docker, GitLab, MicroService, Spring Security, Eureka server,
Config server, Rabbit MQ.
Project 2: Apptio
Apptio, a leading TBM SaaS platform used by enterprises to manage and optimize IT financial operations. Built scalable backend services that supported financial modeling, cloud cost optimization, and IT planning across large-scale infrastructures. Leveraged Spring Boot, JPA, REST APIs, Java 8, and multithreading to deliver high-performance solutions, while integrating MySQL, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases. Implemented CI/CD pipelines with
GitHub Actions, automated deployments, and used Kafka for distributed message processing. Worked extensively with AWS services including RDS, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, Kinesis, and SNS to build cloud-native, event-driven architectures. Improved application performance by optimizing complex SQL queries and ensuring secure, scalable deployments. Provided on-call production support, resolved critical issues, monitored system health, and contributed to documentation.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Implemented features using Core Java, Java 8, Micro Services, Spring Boot. ● Written React components to handle UI functionality and React JS and Redux for implementing core functionality and for Integration.
Utilized Dynamo Db and MySQL. ● Participating in client calls and involved in the requirement gathering from the clients. ● Involved in developing business logic in service layer and persistent logic in DAO Layer. ● Involved in bug fixing and maintenance of the application. ● Contribute to ensuring high quality of code by performing unit testing and following best practices.
Set up CI/CD pipelines using [Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.] to automate testing, integration, and deployment processes.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for seamless communication between services, ensuring efficient data flow and integration.
Proficient in using Spring Framework for dependency injection, inversion of control (IoC), and aspect-oriented programming (AOP).
Expertise in building RESTful and web applications using Spring MVC with features like data binding, form handling, and request mapping
Designed and implemented microservices architecture to break down monolithic applications into smaller, independent services for better scalability, fault isolation, and maintainability.
Involved in business logic to fetch the data from database ● Involved in fix any defects and performance problems discovered during testing. ● Deployed containerized applications using Amazon ECS/EKS, managing clusters with Docker and Kubernetes.
Environment: Java,Java8, Hibernate, Spring Security, Spring IOC, Restfull Web services, Spring Boot with Micro Services, Angular Junit,Mockito,Tomcat 7, Eclipse,Teamcity,SonarQube,postman,OracleSQL Developer,Aws.
,ReactJS
Project-3: B2BBridge
Project name
: B2BBridge
Environment/Tools: Java / J2EE, Spring Boot, Restful web services, ReactsJs, Microservices,Kafka,
MongoDB, Reactjs Hibernate ,Tomcat.
Description:
B2BBridge is a centralized booking and tracking system with an automated dispatching and handling mechanism. Multiple Cab Agencies can connect and handle their bookings with their software. It provides some feature like intercity bookings, Airport bookings, Outstation bookings, Cab for Bus Bookings, Public shared taxi (PST) and Posting bookings, Posting Vehicles to other Cab agencies with their mutual understanding. 3rd party APIs for map and SMS are used in this project.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Developed Airport bookings complete module. ● Developed Public Shared Taxi (PST) Complete module. ● Involved in development of Post Booking module. ● Involved in development of Admin module. ● Direct Client Interaction and fixing Issues. ● Provide user Security for individual cab agency.
Involved in maintenance of this project. ● Involved in Writing SQL Queries and JDBC code to establish connection with MySQL.
